emails.subject: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
Hi team,

Sprint 12 kicks off next Monday. I need everyone's input on the following items by Friday:
1. Feature priorities for this sprint
2. Any technical debt we should address
3. Estimated story points per item

Emma
emails.snippet: Sprint 12 kicks off next Monday. I need everyone's input on the following items.

emails.subject: Re: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
Hi Emma,

From my side:
1. Priority should be the authentication refactor and the dashboard improvements
2. The API rate limiting issue has been causing problems — let's tackle that
3. Auth refactor: 8 points, Dashboard: 5 points, Rate limiting: 3 points

Mike
emails.snippet: Priority should be the authentication refactor and the dashboard improvements.

emails.subject: Re: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
All,

I agree with Mike on the priorities. I'd also add:
- The mobile responsiveness fixes (users have been complaining)
- Documentation updates for the new API endpoints

Mobile fixes: ~5 points, Docs: 2 points

Lisa
emails.snippet: I agree with Mike on the priorities. I'd also add the mobile responsiveness fixes.

emails.subject: Re: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
Team,

Great input! I'll add:
- Performance optimization for the search feature (it's been slow)
- Unit tests coverage improvement (we're at 62%, target 80%)

Search perf: 5 points, Tests: 8 points

That brings our total to 36 points — we might need to cut something. Let's discuss Monday.

- Demo
emails.snippet: Great input! I'll add: Performance optimization for the search feature.

emails.subject: Re: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
Good call on the 36 points. Our velocity has been 28-32 points. We should cut either the test coverage or documentation.

Thoughts? I'm leaning towards deferring docs to sprint 13 since the API is still changing anyway.

Emma
emails.snippet: Good call on the 36 points. Our velocity has been 28-32 points.

emails.subject: Re: Sprint 12 Planning - Input Needed
emails.body:
+1 on deferring docs. The API changes next sprint will make any docs we write now outdated anyway.

So final list: Auth refactor (8), Dashboard (5), Rate limiting (3), Mobile fixes (5), Search perf (5), Tests (8) = 34 points.

That should be doable. See everyone Monday!
Mike
emails.snippet: +1 on deferring docs. Final list: Auth refactor (8), Dashboard (5), Rate limiting (3)...
